build_realtime_audio_buffer: build a VoxtralRealtimeBuffer that manages audio streaming with look-ahead and look-back windows
create_processor_multimodal: create a VoxtralRealtimeMultiModalProcessor for streaming audio transcription with manual placeholder positions
embed_multimodal_audio: embed multimodal audio waveforms into Whisper post-conv embeddings with mel spectrogram processing
generate_offline_prompt: generate an offline transcription prompt from raw audio using TranscriptionRequest and mistral_common tokenizer
encode_time_embeddings: encode time step tensors into sinusoidal embeddings for conditioning the language model
